data.body_html:
The F1 Grand Prix 2032 in Marbella is set to be one of the most spectacular races on the calendar – a street circuit hugging the Costa del Sol coastline. Watching from a grandstand is one thing; watching from the deck of your own private yacht, with the Mediterranean as your backdrop, is something else entirely. This guide covers everything you need to know about chartering a boat for the race weekend: which boats are available, what they cost, where to position yourself, and how to book. Whether you want a fast speedboat for a few hours or a superyacht for the whole weekend, we have a fleet that fits.

Why Watch the F1 Grand Prix 2032 from a Yacht?

The Marbella street circuit runs along the Golden Mile, past Puerto Banús and towards Cabopino. From the water you get an uninterrupted view of the straights and some corners – no crowds, no queues for drinks, and a constant sea breeze. You can anchor within 200 metres of the track. The sound of the engines across the water is visceral. Plus, after the race you cruise back to Puerto Banús for the parties. No traffic jams.

Our Fleet for F1 Weekend 2032

We have 17 boats based in Puerto Banús, ready for race weekend. Below is a selection. All depart from Puerto Banús marina, a 5-minute walk from the paddock.

Best Viewing Spots for the F1 Race

The Marbella circuit is designed for coastal views. The best positions from the water are:

  • Off Cabopino Beach – clear view of the main straight and pit entry. Water depth is 8-12m, easy anchoring.
  • Off Cala del Faro – overlooks the tight corner complex. Good for overtaking action.
  • Near the Río Verde bridge – the yachts can line up along the channel. Closer to the track but busier.

Your skipper knows these spots. They will move the boat during the race if needed. For qualifying day, a 2-hour charter is enough. For race day, book 4 hours minimum.

What’s Included in Every Charter

Every boat comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extras. The Mangusta 80 (both white and grey) includes a free jet ski – perfect for buzzing around between sessions. You can bring your own food and drinks (no glass).

How to Book for F1 Grand Prix 2032

Booking is simple. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) and Tier B (Mangusta 80 variants) you can book directly at the prices listed. For all other yachts – Ferretti 94, Canados 86, Maiora 26m, Pershing 46, etc. – contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. We respond within hours. The fleet books up quickly for race weekend, so early reservation is advised. Payment is by bank transfer or card. A 50% deposit secures the booking.

Itinerary Ideas for Race Weekend

Here are three sample itineraries:

  • Qualifying Day (Saturday): 2-hour charter from 14:00 to 16:00. Cruise to Cabopino, watch qualifying, return to Puerto Banús for evening events. Tier A boat from €749.
  • Race Day (Sunday): 4-hour charter from 13:00 to 17:00. Depart Puerto Banús, anchor off Cala del Faro for the race start, watch the finish, then party on the water. Tier B Mangusta 80 from €4,719.
  • Full Weekend: 6-hour charter on Saturday and 8-hour on Sunday. Use a larger yacht like Ferretti 94. Price on request. Includes lunch, drinks, and jet ski.

All itineraries include skipper and all listed inclusions. You can customise – just ask.
